cues.text: On screen: THE BLENDER FOUNDATION PRESENTS.
Snow-covered mountains loom.
A man stands on a snowy slope.
A muscular arm extends forward, fingers splayed.
A bald man grips a knife, standing on snow.
Sintel lies on snow, red hair fanned, mouth open, a knife rests beside her, her hands clasped.
Snow-covered mountains frame a distant, warmly lit cave entrance.
Sintel stands alone in a vast, snow-laden valley, her red hair contrasting against the white, as jagged, icy peaks loom in the misty distance.
Sintel looks down, her face illuminated.
Sintel walks through a ruined alleyway.
Sintel grips a large, dark object.
Sintel leaps from a rooftop ledge.
Sintel stands on a rooftop, gripping a spear, her red hair catching the light.
Sintel’s eyes open, revealing brown irises, as she looks forward.
A small dragon, Scales, lies on a rooftop with blood on its chest, its mouth open as a human hand reaches toward it.
Sintel holds Scales gently.
A gloved hand places a shallow, dark bowl onto a dark, fringed fabric surface.
Sintel stands in a market alley, scattering apples from a crate.
Sintel, with short red hair and a tattooed arm, stands in a market alley.
Sintel runs up a broken stone staircase toward distant ruins.
Sintel stands atop ruins.
Sintel, with short red hair, stands atop ruins, smiling.
A dragon with large wings hovers near Sintel, who stands atop ruins.
A red-haired girl peeks from behind bamboo stalks.
Sintel extends her hand as Scales approaches.
Sintel’s head peeks over snow.
Sintel strides through deep snow, staff raised, across a vast, foggy landscape with icy cliffs and scattered boulders.
Sintel stands small in the cavern’s shadowed mouth, silhouetted against the glowing moon, her staff held aloft as she faces the vast, icy expanse beyond the cave’s opening.
A small dragon with spiky scales rests motionless on rocky ground within a dark, cavernous space, its form partially obscured by shadow and stone.
Sintel kneels before the dragon, its head glowing as fire erupts from its mouth.
The dragon’s head glows as fire erupts from its mouth, its spiky scales catching the light against the dark, rippling cavern floor.
Sintel draws her spear.
Sintel stands atop the dragon, spear raised.
Sintel leaps from the dragon’s back, her spear flashing as she dives through the air, while the dragon’s glowing head and spiky scales remain visible against the dark cavern floor.
Sintel, with short red hair and a fur-wrapped hand, grips her spear, her expression tense against the dark, cavernous background.
A large dragon rests on the cavern floor, its textured scales and glowing red eye visible, with crystalline formations glowing faintly in the background.
Sintel stands in the dark cavern, her spear gone, looking down.
The dragon's head rests low, its textured scales gleaming under dim light, one glowing red eye fixed forward, with crystalline formations glowing faintly in the background.
A massive, gnarled tree root dominates the foreground, its rough surface detailed, while a small figure sits atop a distant hill under a hazy, warm sky.
Sintel, with short red and grey hair and a shoulder wound, looks down, her expression heavy, in the dim cavern.
A rusted, broken leather strap with a buckle lies discarded on a rough, textured rock surface.
